CLASSIFICATION OF HIGH BLOOD PRESSURE


Lose weight—If you are overweight, losing weight is the
most effective non-drug method for lowering blood
pressure.  A weight loss of as little as 10 pounds can sig-
nificantly reduce blood pressure in many overweight people
with high blood pressure.  In some people, weight loss
alone is sufficient to avoid the need for blood pressure
medication.
Exercise—When compared with more active and fit
peers, sedentary individuals with normal blood pressure
have a 20 to 50 percent increased risk for development of
high blood pressure. Regular aerobic exercise such as walking
